title: How Gender Interacts with Political Values: A Case Study on Czech BERT Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting masked language models with political opinion statements to compute agreement and disagreement probabilities, mapping them to a scale, and comparing the model scores against human responses from a representative sociological survey across four political value categories (Anti-authoritarianism, Cultural liberalism, Economic equity, Tribalism).

Comparing the models' assigned probabilities of agreeing or disagreeing with political statements when the prompt templates are formatted using feminine versus masculine grammatical gender for the assumed speaker.
